title: M PLUS Rounded 1c
description: A Japanese gothic with a soft, rounded impression. Weights run from Thin to Black, and the eased outline carries a casual, familiar tone. Published on Google Fonts, and widely used for Japanese captions. The binaries (static weights, only Medium, ExtraBold, and Black, matching real use in the caption catalog) are already bundled at assets/font/mplus-rounded-1c/ in this repo (noted 2026-07-23. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Scenes that want a soft caption heading or a pop emphasis line, for a vlog, entertainment, a tutorial, or kids and family, where a stiff tone would be wrong
ai_usage: 取得後は強調テロップの見出しに Bold〜Black、本文字幕に Regular〜Medium を使う想定。丸みのあるグリフ形状は改変しない。フォーマルな企業 VP・法人向け資料などの硬いトーンには使わず、カジュアル/ポップな文脈を優先して採用する。同梱済みの実体は Medium(500)/ExtraBold(800)/Black(900) の3ウェイトのみ（Thin/Light/Regular/Bold は同梱していない・必要なら追加取得）

provenance.origin: AKARI Video 素材カタログ収録（Google Fonts / M+ FONTS Project, Coji Morishita）/ 2026-07-14
